documentation_notes.finding: Word0 is called the SDK/kernel ABI, but the existing startup word0 represents boot mode. Native calculator correctly queries native::check_abi() and does not use word0 as ABI.
documentation_notes.requested_fix: Describe word0 as boot mode and ABI validation as an explicit native syscall query.

STOP before GO closes the four untransferred service handles; active stop tries both typed owners even when one close fails, then native DONE is sent before registry/control closure. Failure exits rather than claiming clean DONE.
